story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: From a hello to forever
intro: It all began with a simple hello beneath the students' tree. Year after year, that friendship led us here.

items.title: Law school
items.subtitle: Just classmates
items.description: A hello, a smile, then conversations through a mutual friend. A quiet friendship began.

items.title: France
items.subtitle: Miles apart
items.description: Geovanni moved to France. Despite the distance and our new lives, we stayed close.

items.title: Tunisia, then France
items.subtitle: Never really far apart
items.description: By December, the friendship we treasured had quietly become a long-distance love story.

items.title: Together in France
items.subtitle: What if it was written?
items.description: Stella joined Geovanni in France and discovered he had cared for her long before she knew.

items.title: Forever
items.subtitle: Our most beautiful chapter
items.description: Years after that first hello, we are choosing each other and celebrating our union with you.

closing: A story that began with hello now has its most beautiful forever.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Need help?
contact.copy: So the couple can enjoy their day with complete peace of mind, our wedding planners are available for any question. Please contact them directly by phone or WhatsApp before or during the wedding.

items.question: Do we need two different outfits for the ceremony and the reception?
items.answer: No, it's not mandatory, there are colors that work for both the ceremony and the reception; here they are: #D8D0C2 #DCC9A6 #914F3C

items.question: If we don't have Revolut, can we give a material gift?
items.answer: The payment link is accessible even if you don't have Revolut. If you run into any issues, please contact one of the two wedding planners. The couple does not wish to receive material gifts.

items.question: Do we get discounts at the listed hotels?
items.answer: Unfortunately not, this list is provided for information only, to save you some research. You are free to choose other hotels and/or Airbnb options.

items.question: Are there any specific arrangements for children?
items.answer: The reception venue has a room dedicated to children. However, each parent is responsible for their own child, and no childcare service will be provided.

items.question: During the break from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM, can we wait at the reception venue?
items.answer: The reception venue will be in the midst of preparations for the evening and unfortunately won't be able to welcome you before 4:00 PM. This will also be a special moment the couple wants to share, just the two of them, before joining you again for the rest of the celebrations! We therefore invite you to make the most of this break to rest at your accommodation or explore the city.

items.question: Can I bring a plus-one?
items.answer: Invitations are individual and personal, so the couple can share this moment with the people who matter most to them. If your partner has not received the site access link and password, this unfortunately means they have not been invited to the event. Thank you for your understanding and for respecting this wish, which means a great deal to the couple. If you are a couple or a family and each of you has received the link and password, please register individually, including children aged 2 and over.
